news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Financial Results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, August 13, 2026, After Close of U.S.-Based Financial Markets
news.summary: Nektar announced it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026 after U.S. markets close. President and CEO Howard Robin will host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET to review the results, including progress on rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Is Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Undervalued On Its Phase 3 Rezpegaldesleukin Launch?
news.summary: The analysis weighs whether Nektar's stock remains undervalued after the company launched its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin, considering the drug's clinical profile against the company's current market valuation.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar initiated the first two of three planned global registrational Phase 3 trials (ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in patients aged 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis who have not previously used biologics or systemic JAK inhibitors. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3, for patients with prior biologic/JAK experience, rounds out the registrational program, which spans North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar's Organization and Compensation Committee granted non-qualified stock options to purchase 36,000 shares to 23 newly hired employees under the company's 2025 Inducement Plan. The options carry an exercise price of $64.84, matching the stock's closing price on the grant date, an eight-year term, and four-year vesting.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 10.65% on July 2, 2026, moving from the mid-$50s to around $71, amid improving investor sentiment toward the immunology sector and momentum ahead of the ZENITH AD Phase 3 launch.

news.headline: What a $1.2 Million Insider Sale Means for Nektar With Shares Up 160% This Past Year
news.summary: Nektar CEO Howard Robin sold 20,000 shares in open-market transactions in mid-June for about $1.22 million, roughly 26.6% of his direct holdings. The disclosure comes as NKTR shares have risen approximately 160% over the trailing year amid optimism around rezpegaldesleukin's advancement into Phase 3.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Nektar will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close and host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET led by CEO Howard Robin, with updates expected on ZENITH AD Phase 3 enrollment progress and cash runway.

catalysts.label: NKTR-0165 preclinical data presentation
catalysts.detail: Preclinical data from the NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist antibody) program targeting tissue-specific regulatory T cells is expected to be presented at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: A third global registrational trial, ZENITH AD-3, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic or JAK inhibitor experience, is planned to complete the three-trial ZENITH AD Phase 3 program that began with AD-1 and AD-2 in July 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to start a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, building on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 initial readout
catalysts.detail: Initial top-line results from the ZENITH AD Phase 3 registrational program in atopic dermatitis are expected around mid-2028, per company guidance given at trial initiation.

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 (TrialNet) initial data
catalysts.detail: Initial data from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in new-onset Type 1 diabetes mellitus is expected in 2027.

pulse: Nektar remains in a pivotal build-up phase, having launched the first two global registrational Phase 3 trials (ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2) for rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis on July 21, 2026, with a third trial (AD-3) and a separate alopecia areata Phase 3 program still to follow. The stock has rallied roughly 160% over the past year on optimism about REZPEG's differentiated Treg-biology profile, even as insiders including the CEO and R&D chief have trimmed portions of their personal stakes under pre-set trading plans. With no major new disclosures since late July, attention now turns to Q2 2026 earnings on August 13, where investors will look for updates on trial enrollment pace, cash runway, and pipeline milestones including NKTR-0165 preclinical data expected later this year.
